_comment: Beta Survey Tracker — Configuration File
Upload this file to S3 alongside index.html.
The Lambda function reads this to know which surveys to export.
HOW TO CUSTOMIZE:
1. Set 'aliasQuestionId' to the Qualtrics question ID that collects
the participant's alias (e.g., 'Q3'). Find this in Survey Builder
by clicking the question and looking at the Question ID.
2. Add your programs to the 'programs' array. Each program has:
- name: Display name shown on the dashboard
- surveys: Array of survey objects, each with:
- id:    Qualtrics Survey ID (starts with 'SV_')
- label: Human-readable survey name
- due:   Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format
To find your Survey ID: go to your Qualtrics survey →
Survey → Tools → Survey ID (also in the URL).
ADDING A NEW PROGRAM: Copy one of the program blocks below
and update the name/surveys. Re-upload to S3. The Lambda
will pick it up on the next run (within 30 min).
REMOVING A SURVEY: Just delete it from this file and re-upload.
The completions.json will stop including it on the next refresh.
